1.t: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?

2.t: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?

3.t: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,

4.t: Striking them with stones of baked clay.

5.t: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
